source: Make one nominal CAD rectangular motor adapter plate named motor_plate. Its overall size is 80 mm in local X, 60 mm in local Y and 6 mm in local Z, centered on the local origin. It must be one solid. It has exactly five uniform cylindrical through-holes parallel to local Z: one 22 mm diameter hole at local XY (0, 0), and four 5.2 mm diameter holes at (-30, -20), (-30, 20), (30, -20) and (30, 20) mm. Use a symmetric diameter tolerance of 0.05 mm and a radial position tolerance of 0.05 mm for each hole. I need nominal CAD and digital files only. Give me editable native CAD, STEP, STL and a prepared print package.
